title: Dynamically Refined Regularization for Improving Cross-corpora Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving hate speech detection systems by reducing spurious correlations related to group identifiers, including gender and religious groups. While it addresses social bias and includes an Ethical Considerations section, its primary task is the technical improvement of detection performance rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as systems of thought or reasoning.
